_note: report-progress's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. Positives are real requests for a PM-style PROGRESS / STATUS report on a bounded body of work: what moved this period, RAG signals, blockers, risks, milestone tracking, owners, dates, next steps. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from the three near-synonymous report-* siblings — a comprehensive current-STATE / situation snapshot across a whole system is report-state; a CIA-style intel BRIEF for rapid knowledge transfer is report-brief; a formal STRATEGY brief with glossary + recommendations is report-strategic — plus resume-author. The hard boundary is report-state: progress = a bounded project's STATUS over a period (what moved); state = a whole system's comprehensive condition snapshot (what exists / where we stand). Each negative belongs to a NAMED sibling. routing-eval is lexical-overlap only; 'status'/'health' overlap with report-state is a proxy limit, not a defect.
